contract.child: One root-preprovisioned isolated child has taskd-local ID 1.
contract.request: The lifecycle probe sends exactly START(1) on its sole client endpoint.
contract.lifecycle: taskd validates completion generation 1, invokes Suspend then Resume on its delegated child TCB cap, sends one second start token, validates generation 2, then signals dedicated probe success.
contract.authority: taskd receives only the declared fixed child TCB and protocol IPC caps; the proof path has no root runtime child activation or control.

required_markers: SeLinOS taskd M1: exact START(1) accepted.
SeLinOS taskd M1: child completion generation 1 validated.
SeLinOS taskd M1: fixed child TCB suspended and resumed.
SeLinOS taskd M1: child completion generation 2 validated.
SeLinOS taskd M1: fixed child lifecycle completed without clone semantics.
SeLinOS task lifecycle M1 probe: fixed child taskd lifecycle passed.
forbidden_markers: SeLinOS taskd M1: malformed fixed-child request rejected.
SeLinOS taskd M1: first child completion rejected.
SeLinOS taskd M1: second child completion rejected.
SeLinOS taskd M1: fixed child TCB suspend/resume failed.
SeLinOS task lifecycle M1 probe: taskd reply rejected.

not_claimed: Linux clone, fork, pthread or general process-lifecycle semantics
dynamic child TCB, CSpace, VSpace, stack, register-image or PID allocation
parent child TID, clear-child-tid, futex exit, wait, signals or task teardown
shared address spaces, file tables, TLS, credentials, namespaces or scheduler policy
